distance.proof: bilby.gw.prior.UniformSourceFrame(minimum=10.0, maximum=10000.0, cosmology='Planck15_LAL', name='luminosity_distance', latex_label='$d_L$', unit='Mpc', boundary=None)

fit.target: Joint Mc_source,eta,six L-frame Cartesian spins,redshift; other extrinsics and tides where present use native PE conditional priors.

source_chart_coverage.policy: Finite-chart rows only for optimization; unchanged original rows/weights/groups retained in native validation. Generic references use the closed-domain native-prior density, including divergent equal-mass/spin-zero limits. No jitter or point-mass boundary certificate; each original split must retain at least99.9% chart coverage.

fit.nuisance_scope: Native PE conditional calibration, sky, orientation, time, phase and tides; full redshift and all six reference-frequency spins retained
fit.chart_boundary_scope: Absolutely continuous 9D priors only. No exact-aligned, zero-spin, total-transverse-cancellation or equal-mass boundary-limit certificate. Negative infinity there is a chart-domain sentinel, not a physical waveform claim; use separately validated lower-dimensional products when appropriate.

selection.rule: highest native posterior weighted log density on tuning-only intrinsic groups

rf_selection.rule: tuning-only native posterior weighted log score; final original-group holdout untouched

rf_correction.feature_definition: geometric4 nonredundant chart with circular sin/cos azimuth, plus derived spin magnitudes, chi_eff and chi_p for a scalar correction; these predictors do not redefine the physical measure
rf_correction.scope: positive finite-tree density correction; uncapped downstream importance weights; posterior normalization required

support_normalization.method: uncapped importance integral of finite positive tree tilt over exact wrapped-Gaussian proposal and physical coupled support
support_normalization.normalization_field_note: posterior_normalization is the complete tilted integral; posterior_support_probability is the base physical acceptance probability

fit.validation_scope: Joint9D geometric4 density/prior ratio; actual recorded original-intrinsic-group train/tune/heldout split; tuning information recorded but not mistaken for independent validation; finite observables/projections and declared prior families only; no independent PE or waveform error certificate

relocation_witness.method: remove_only_bounds.distance.dl_and_log_pdf_dl; exact canonical restoration checked at export
